claims.subject: SOO-1
claims.quote: Applies to zone ZN-1 heating only.

claims.subject: SOO-1
claims.value: The zone controller TC-2101 reads zone air temperature from TT-2101 and enables the preheat coil on a simple two-position sequence with deadband. There is no optimum start, no night setback and no morning boost in this revision.
claims.quote: The zone controller TC-2101 reads zone air temperature from TT-2101 and enables the preheat coil on a simple two-position sequence with deadband. There is no optimum start, no night setback and no morning boost in this revision.

claims.subject: SOO-1
claims.value: From system start the coil is enabled. The coil remains enabled while the zone is below the upper deadband limit.
claims.quote: **Step 1 — Warmup.** From system start the coil is enabled. The coil remains enabled while the zone is below the upper deadband limit.

claims.subject: SOO-1
claims.value: When TT-2101 reaches 21.5 degC the coil is disabled. The coil is re-enabled when TT-2101 falls to 20.5 degC. The zone then cycles between these two limits.
claims.quote: **Step 2 — Hold.** When TT-2101 reaches 21.5 degC the coil is disabled. The coil is re-enabled when TT-2101 falls to 20.5 degC. The zone then cycles between these two limits.

claims.subject: SOO-1
claims.value: The deadband limits above are the commissioned values.
claims.quote: The deadband limits above are the commissioned values.

claims.subject: SOO-1
claims.quote: The heating setpoint quoted in the design basis (21 degC) is the midpoint of the deadband and is not itself a switching point.

claims.subject: SOO-2
claims.value: The preheat coil shall not be enabled unless the zone temperature transmitter is reading a plausible value. TT-2101 is regarded as plausible above -40 degC.
claims.quote:
SOO-2  Interlocks
The preheat coil shall not be enabled unless the zone temperature transmitter is reading a plausible value. TT-2101 is regarded as plausible above -40 degC.
